# KWIIN Mobile Spa

KWIIN is Pratana Halstrick's mobile Thai massage service for homes, hotels, private suites, and offices in the Zurich region, Switzerland.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://kwiin.ch/
- Mobile Spa: https://kwiin.ch/mobile-spa/
- Treatments and prices: https://kwiin.ch/services/
- About Pratana: https://kwiin.ch/about/
- Contact and booking: https://kwiin.ch/contact/
- International massage and spa coaching: https://kwiin.ch/international/
- Planned courses: https://kwiin.ch/courses/
- Planned shop: https://kwiin.ch/shop/
- Booking information and terms: https://kwiin.ch/terms/

## Key facts

- Pratana brings a professional massage table, oils, and fresh towels.
- Travel up to 15 km costs CHF 45 in addition to the treatment price.
- Travel up to 30 km costs CHF 100 in addition to the treatment price.
- Longer distances can be requested directly.
- Booking is handled personally on WhatsApp at +41 77 966 99 28.
- International massage and spa coaching are individually quoted and use separate contracts.
- Courses and the shop are in preparation. Course dates, certification partners, products and prices are not yet confirmed. There is no online checkout or course enrolment.
- Workplace visits are available for up to four hours per day by arrangement.
- Thirty-minute Crown Serenity and Bata Flow are add-ons to another treatment, without a second travel charge.
- The website is available in German, English, Thai, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, and Portuguese.
For full, current service details and prices, use the canonical pages above.
